answers.core: This seems like a pretty common use case, and would be helpful with more frictionless level editing.
answers.workaround: You need to do check "Editable Children" which bloats the Scene tree. There is no way to override the duplicate function to have custom functionality (as far as I know) - I would be happy with a solution that would allow me to override the duplicate functionality on an instanced Scene.

title: Make Unique per Duplicate Resource Option
